Let me search for more specific information about the annexation document and the governor who signed it.
Captaincy General of Guatemala Cádiz Cortes 1812 provincial division
The region joined the First Mexican Empire by annexation after the Act of Independence of Central America.
His request was accepted on 5 January 1822.
The Consultive Junta of Guatemala City was the Central American government at the time, not the Captain General.
Gabino Gainza Fernandez de Medrano is mentioned as the "jefe político superior" (governor) of Guatemala
On 5 January 1822, Gaínza sent a letter to Iturbide accepting Central America's annexation
The text mentions the annexation into the First Mexican Empire and that Gabino Gainza was the Captain General.
The document authorizing annexation was sent by Gaínza on 5 January 1822.
Gabino Gaínza was the last Captain General before independence and then the first Captain General of Central America under Mexican rule. He sent a letter accepting annexation on 5 January 1822.
Gabino Gaínza Fernández de Medrano, who was the "jefe político superior" (governor) of Guatemala
Gabino Gaínza was the head of the junta and would have signed the document.
